name: tokenchit
description: Turn your local AI coding agent logs into an embeddable stat card.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tokenchit/core && npm run build -w @tokenchit/cli && npm run build -w tokenchit-site
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @tokenchit/cli && npm run test -w @tokenchit/core && npm run test -w @tokenchit/cli
